newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rikadenki says won't repeat failure to pay notes.
newsitem.headline: Rikadenki says won't repeat failure to pay notes.

text.p: Rikadenki Kogyo Co Ltd said late on Wednesday that it had a problem in honouring promissory notes for the first time earlier this month, but could avoid any repetition of such a problem for now.

Shares of Rikadenki Kogyo were suspended from trade in the over-the-counter (OTC) market on Wednesday afternoon after private research company Teikoku Databank said in a report that the company had failed to honour promissory notes for the first time last Friday. Trading in the shares resumed on Thursday.

Rikadenki, which makes various measurement instruments, said in a statement that the problem occurred after the company put an incorrect payment date on its promissory notes and that it completed payments on February 24.
It said it currently holds debts worth 1.51 billion yen and that it would be able to avoid a repetition of such problems this month.
